name: main_program
purpose: the entry point: unit start-ups (incl. 0791:F3F2), then unless 1771:080C returns non-zero: 214B:179C, 1771:9B85, 1771:2D15, 000E:68A4 per manager, 1771:76B1, 000E:60CB per manager; always ends in the main menu 000E:7439, then halts

name: unmanage_country
purpose: the reset when a manager's country is released (a manager's leaving, inferred): before any test it writes 1 to two bytes of manager m's records, then calls reset_team_tactics (0791:BC5D) for m's country while it is still managed (so 52CC sorts with the managed rule); then it copies +7 to +6 for slots 12..20, clears byte 0 of the manager's 80 extra players, writes the country's own number to +0x2E, after which 0B77 no longer reports it managed, and turns the country's fixtures with first byte 0xFE into 0xFF

name: crowd_animation
purpose: fills the per-seat crowd data: two nested loops (50 x 10) of rand(5), rand(0x50) and, when the seat byte is below 7, rand(0xF) - 1000-1500 draws per call - ending with 214B:1E09; called only from the key waits 000E:04F5 (a 16-iteration loop) and 000E:0572 (until a key), so it never runs inside a quick-result half (one call exceeds a tenth of the half's draws and the pause seeds are stable), but any model of the menu or attract screens must treat it as an RNG consumer

name: simulate_fixture
purpose: plays a fixture without a watched match: 0791:D47E (a result without display), then 0791:B7FA, B602 and D050, in that order, then reset_team_tactics (0791:BC5D) for both teams with no test of 0B77; the fixture router sends the fixtures that are not watched here

name: maybe_ask_watch_match
purpose: the fixture router's gate: returns 1 without calling 0791:E80D when its flag argument is 0, else returns what E80D (ask_watch_match) returns

name: route_fixture
purpose: routes one fixture by its first byte: 0xFE goes to the gate 000E:6C21 with flag 1 only when both teams are unmanaged (1771:0B77), and on a returned 1 to 000E:6E15, where fixture byte +2 = 0 calls 0791:BB2F and otherwise 0791:F1F6; any other first byte, or a 0 from the gate, goes to 000E:6DAE, where membership in the set at 0x695A, or in the set at 0x697A with a nonzero continent flag, can call the gate with flag 1 (and 6E15 on a 1), and otherwise the fixture goes to 000E:6970; so a fixture with a managed team and first byte 0xFE never reaches E80D or 6970

name: play_round
purpose: item 6's action when the last manager continues: sets [DS:A923]+1 = 1, plays fixtures through 000E:6CA7; when the fixture index +0x26 reaches the count +0x28, calls 1771:8208 and the stage dispatch 1771:76B1 (000E:7072 always returns 0), then, if the stage byte +0x3C is in the set at CS:7099, 000E:60CB for each manager whose +0x47 flag is clear

name: main_menu_loop
purpose: the main-menu loop (the top-level screens); on Enter with item 6 it can reach 000E:70B9

name: create_managed_replacement
purpose: makes a managed country's replacement in the fresh record 000E:56F3 put in the retiree's slot: 1771:96D3(1, retiree +7, country, new) with the managed fitness branch (550E-5534), then +1 = DS:0x78[gk] + b - a with a, b = rand(6) (5539-556F; DS:0078 = 19 1C, 25/28), 1771:32EB, caps/goals/status zeroed (5584-5594), a new initial from 1771:0000 (5599-55AD); then counts squad slots 1..20 and the manager's 80 pool words with +1 < DS:0x76[gk] + 4 (55B5-56AA; DS:0076 = 11 14), the new record included, and below 0x14 sets +1 = DS:0x76[gk] + rand(3) and runs 32EB again (56AC-56E8)

name: replace_retiree
purpose: replaces one managed-country retiree: sets the manager's flag [A923]+0x4D+m (570D), runs the retirement news 000E:50D4 when announced (5712-571E), 1771:1B2E twice, takes a fresh record from 1771:4CF7 (5745) and stores its number in the retiree's pool slot or squad slot (574D-579C), makes it with 000E:54F0 (57A6), zeroes the retiree's 20 bytes with 214B:0018 (57C0), then 000E:544D and 000E:05F6 when announced

name: managed_retirement_scan
purpose: the managed countries' retirement path, from the main menu's Enter on item 6 (000E:7439, 7785): returns 0 in year 0 (+0x38, 580C) or when the manager's flag +0x4D+m is set (5824); unless +0x13+m is set or 0791:DB38 returns nonzero, the first squad slot 1..20 that 1771:7F40 retires is replaced at once by 000E:56F3(retiree, 1) (5864-5897); else the 80 pool words are walked cyclically from DS:6D18[m] - 1 + rand(0x50) (58A3-5946) and the first retiree is replaced by 56F3(retiree, caps > 0); returns 1 after a replacement; no step asks the user

name: draw_initial
purpose: a new name initial: r = rand(byte DS:0C38 = 0x15) through 214B:06B1 (0006-000C), returns DS:0C38[r] (0013), one of the 21 letters ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPRSTVW; one draw; called by 1771:7E80 (7F1F), 000E:54F0 (5599) and 1771:09A0

name: draw_match_summary
purpose: builds a board in DS:A96E: header via A699 (0x27A0/0x276E chosen by the argument), score (0712), 9 statistics per side from DS:7B7E (10 bytes per side), counters DS:80F2/80F6, team names, scorers from DS:7BD1 with minutes (a different mark when byte >= 0x81); then copies it to DS:A96A

name: match_delay
purpose: match_delay(n): calls 214B:1E09(n) only when the speed byte [DS:A923]+0x3F is above 0

name: match_whistle
purpose: the whistle(n): plays a sound only when the speed byte [DS:A923]+0x3F is above 0, like 0791:0425; called at the end of each half

name: draw_big_digits
purpose: formats arg2 (DS:831B in D733) as decimal and draws its digits as 7-segment shapes (table DS:0644) at columns 0x45/0x4B of the screen at DS:A96A

name: draw_score
purpose: draws the goals byte DS:9B3C+1 at (0x1F,2) and DS:9B3C at (0x1F,4), attribute 0x70, into the given screen buffer

name: save_goal_file
purpose: saves the goal to a file: builds a file name (214B:09DA number to string, concatenation), calls 0791:09C4 with mode 0 (create, through 214B:1BB7), retries on a DOS file error (214B:1869), closes the handle (214B:1A36)

name: ask_do_you_want
purpose: a timed Y/N prompt: shows "Do you want " + its string argument + "? (Y/N)" on the bottom line, waits 0791:CC2E(600), returns 1 only when a key is waiting and it is Y, 0 with no key; the action-replay and save-goal questions both use it

name: action_replay
purpose: the action replay after a goal (tick loop, when DS:7C37 is set): when [DS:A923]+0x41 and DS:0C1E are set, asks "Do you want an action replay?" (0791:0B7C) and skips on no, then asks "to save this goal" and on yes calls 0791:0A6B; the rest (from 0CB2, not read for this row) is what F005 calls the replay code

name: commentary_record_is_new
purpose: a predicate: compares a proposed commentary record (code and two player words, side) with the newest entry of the ring at DS:7C38 + 6 * DS:80EE and returns whether they differ; it stores nothing (its caller 0791:1D4A advances the ring and writes)

name: resort_pitch_and_bench
purpose: per team: sorts the pitch records of slots 0668[t]+1..+11 by the position key (0xE when unavailable, else +6; jb: a smaller key swaps up), each pitch swap also swapping the same two squad words of the country record (0791:2218) and the shadow bytes at DS:9B07; then a260 re-derives pitch+6 (the address slot) and pitch+0xD (the squad word) for all eleven slots; then a bench sort of squad words 12..20 by the players' +6; the DS:830B/830C/830D bytes are re-pointed at the swapped slots; called after every substitution (c5dc at C7A7) and from C01A's tail

name: player_effective_tactic
purpose: returns the player's effective tactic element k: element k of the player's +0xF (own_tactic_set) when k < 5 and +0xF element k + 4 is set (the player's own setting), else element k of +0x2D (default_team_tactic_set) of the country in the player's byte 0; the watched engine reaches it through its event routines (3111 asks k 3, 42CB k 1, 4532 k 7 and 1, 4649 k 6 and 5, 4A28 k 5 and 1, 4B64 k 6, 5 and 7, 4DA9 k 4, 4E28 k 1, 5049 k 2, 5729 k 6), the quick result through 0791:D5C1

name: player_unavailable_on_pitch
purpose: takes a pitch-slot record (DS:80E8 + slot*0x16) and returns 1771:3216 for its player index at +0xD, so 1 when that player cannot play

name: pitch_slot_side
purpose: returns pitch+6 < 0x0C: 1 for the pitch slots 1..11 and 0 for the slots 12..22 - the same test 0791:2996 makes on DS:830B

name: ball_holder_is_side0
purpose: returns DS:830B < 0x0C, i.e. the slot on the ball is one of slots 1..11 (the side whose base in the table at DS:0668 is 0); used as a 0/1 side index everywhere

name: slot_is_on_ball_side
purpose: returns 2996() == 2974(pitch): the pitch record's side equals the side of the current ball slot DS:830B; 65FE's form update and 65A4 use it

name: attack_direction
purpose: returns DS:7920[team ^ half] (a sign, multiplied by 5/6/0x27/'$' at call sites); team = slot<0x0C via 2974, half flag = DS:8319 < DS:831B

name: player_at_ball
purpose: returns 1 when the record's position word (+0 x, +1 y) equals the ball position word DS:82F6

name: in_own_goal_area
purpose: with position p: true when y*attack_direction < 0 (own end), abs(y) > 0x20 and abs(x) < 3; 9564 calls it on the side's slot-1 (keeper) record with DS:82F6

name: find_nearest_to_ball
purpose: for each side, over slots base+2..base+11 that can play, are not DS:830B and are not in state 13: nearest to the ball by Manhattan distance goes to DS:8311[side]; nearest that is goal-side of the ball goes to DS:830F[side]

name: check_woodwork
purpose: when the ball is moving (DS:8300 != 0), the holder is not a keeper (045D: slot 1 or 12), abs(y) = 0x25 and abs(x) < 2: 593B may bounce it back (velocities DS:82FC/82FE negated, speed /4, commentary from table DS:07FA) and the routine then returns 1

name: handle_player_at_ball
purpose: watched match only (DS:9A3E = 0), state +0x12 not 13, player on the ball square (2CEC): a keeper calls 5B36, another player not already holding (DS:830B) calls 5F8A

name: repick_kickoff_keeper
purpose: when 0791:045D says DS:830B is a keeper slot {1,12}: draws rand(10) and sets DS:830B := r + 1 + DS:0668[2996()], staying on the same side of the pitch; 65A4 calls it (the watched engine's 8206 too); no other draws

name: record_goal
purpose: (minute, slot, side): commentary 0x26 (0x27 when DS:7C39 is set, and then the other side is credited), adds 1 to the scorer's player word +0x0A, gives the scorer +0xC := clamp(s8(+0xC) + s8(DS:0x7920[7C39!=0?0:1])) through 7CC5 (+1 in a quick match, read by 377E so the scorer's strength shifts from the next minute on) and +0x12 += s8(DS:0x720[ring id 0x26]) = +40, adds 1 to the count DS:80F0[side] (up to 11), and stores the player and minute in the scorer list DS:7BD1 + side*0x21 + n*3 (+0x80 when DS:8324 or 7C39 is set)

name: reset_pitch_states
purpose: per pitch slot 1..22: pitch+0x12 := 6 when 0791:2B51 says the slot is on DS:830B's side and 0791:045D says it is not a keeper, else 0; then calls 0791:6337

name: after_goal
purpose: after a goal: DS:8325 := 1, whistle(4) (0441 - the goal pause, no RNG), copies pitch+0 to pitch+7 per slot (display), 0791:65A4, 0791:C173, then the per-slot form update: for every slot whose 2956 is 0 (available), 0791:7CC5(pitch, 0, s8(DS:0x7920[2B51])) - DS:0x7920 is 0xFF,0x01, so the side of DS:830B gains 1 form on every available player and the other side loses 1, shifting both line sums from the next minute on; then DS:832A := 50*(two score compares) and, when DS:9A3E, DS:9B55 := 1; 0791:D733 calls it after 0106(0)

name: walk_player_off
purpose: walks pitch record n (DS:80E8 + 0x16 n) to the point DS:0642 with the clock stopped (DS:8325 and DS:9B41 saved and cleared): per pass update_player, then each of the 22 records steps (0791:8537) with 214B:1E09(2) at speed 0 or (1) at speed 1, until 0791:2CC5; then sets its position to DS:0640 (the off-pitch value); does nothing if it is already there

name: adjust_player_form
purpose: (pitch, flag, delta): sets live +0xC to clamp(s8(+0xC)+delta,1,255); nonzero flag writes min(32,s8(new live)) to DS:9B07[side*20+slot] via 2BB1/2974, not a card draw; scorer 6443 uses flag one, team-wide 65FE uses zero; the calling convention is push(delta_high, delta_low, pitch_high, pitch_low, cs), then near call; the routine reads [bp + 6] = pitch_low, [bp + 8] = pitch_high, [bp + 0xc] = delta_high (the addend), and the LOW BYTE of [bp + 0xa] = delta_low as the persist flag (whether to write DS:9B07); send_off head (7B77) and injure (7D56) push (0xfffe, 0x0001) so delta_high=-2 and flag=1; send_off tail (7B77) pushes (2, 0) over the OTHER side's available pitch slots so delta_high=+2 and flag=0; scorer (6443) pushes s8(DS:0x7920[side_of_credit]) and 0x0001; team reaction (65FE) pushes s8(DS:0x7920[side_of_ball]) and 0x0000

name: timed_notice
purpose: saves the bottom line, shows screen DS:5B30 or (p2 set: keeper unavailable) DS:5B66 with the side's country name on row 25, waits 0791:CC2E(DS:087C[p2]), reads a waiting key, else writes Esc to DS:A977; restores the bottom line

name: check_substitutions
purpose: per side: a computer side (1771:0B77 = 0) with DS:9B3A[side] > 0 scans squad slots s = 11 down to 2 (pitch slot 0668[side]+s) and calls C88D when the player's +0x10 element 6 is clear, +0xE > 0, 1 < DS:831B < 0x23 and the player's signed +0x12 word < 0x5A - DS:831B; the scan stops at slot 1 after a substitution that exhausts the budget; a managed side acts only on DS:9B40 (0 throughout a quick match) via the prompt 7FCF/ED8A; called by the quick engine's D733 once per minute without a goal, and in the watched engine at each dead ball (61EC, 6E11, 6E6E, 6ECF, 6F01, 6F3E) and at each half's start (983F): E011 enters it 26 times, 81B1 (the test passed) twice

name: watched_foul_sequence
purpose: the watched engine's foul, from 5513 (the challenger lost the tackle roll and 4DA9 holds, then a coin) and from 5B36's duel branch (the keeper lost the roll, 4DA9, coin); arg = the fouler's pitch slot (+6) -> DS:830C = DS:830D; returns with no foul when 2EB8(the fouler's own position word, his record) holds and a coin (214B:06FA) holds; else commentary 2AA3(0x37) 'is brought down' and 2AD4(0x35) 'FOUL by', 7E60's animation, the Fouls count DS:7B84[side*10] += 1, then 7EEF (card or injury rolls); then, when 2EB8(the ball position DS:82F6, the fouler's record) holds, an unmanaged fouler gets 1771:33CD and 6ECF (penalty) runs, else 6FB6 (free kick). Not a substitution display (F012's reading): the strings are 'FOUL by' and 'is brought down' and E011's 3 entries equal DS:7B84 of both sides (2 + 1)

name: move_ball
purpose: adds the velocity (+6, +8) to the ball record at DS:82F6, counts the timer at +0x0A down, redraws (8F10); when out of bounds (2DCA: abs(x)<9, abs(y)<0x26 is in play) it picks the restart: abs(x)<2 calls 698E/690C, else abs(y)<0x26 calls 6E11, else 6E6E or 6F01, depending on which end

name: player_run_step
purpose: per updated pitch record (from 8AE9; up to 28 per sweep - the 22 slot tails returning to 96CB plus the keeper special returning to 9669 once per ball phase, up to six ball phases per sweep; the 23 of rng-counts.txt is the COIN maximum, a different quantity): the early exits at 8894 (DS:8302=0), 88E4 (the holder DS:830B) and 88F8 (DS:830C) jump to 88D3/89E5, INSIDE the routine, skipping only the advancement block 8896-89E1, and the state filter at 8985 (+0x12 in the set CS:8869 = {5,7,8,11}) likewise only skips 899A-89E1 - so every record reaches the target test: 2CC5 = 0 (not on its target square) draws ONE coin (214B:06FA at 8A2E) choosing the run axis (byte +0xF = 1/2 by x sign, 3/4 by y, else 5), then the movement loop 8AC5-8AE1 draws rand(5) at 8AD1 for a fresh direction per FAILED 86D0 move and retries - the per-tick movement draws; instrumented half: 33532 coins (8754 with 8302=0, 1280 holder, 218 on 830C), 2488 rand(5) retries and max 28 update_player calls per sweep (E011 rng-counts.txt)

name: update_player
purpose: runs the +0x12 state handler, then 8889; adds one to pitch +0x14 when unsigned pitch +0xF <5; after ball and drawing calls, when DS:8325 nonzero and unsigned counter >180, decrements signed player energy >1 by one, and resets counter even if decrement suppressed; fitness untouched

name: track_offside_line
purpose: per side 0..1, over the side's outfield pitch slots 0668[side]+2..+11, keeps in the six-byte sprite record at DS:82E2+6*side (the byte at +1) the minimum signed advancement y*attack direction (2BE5) against an accumulator that starts at ZERO (8D1F; 8D90 jge 8DAD keeps the earlier, so a positive product never replaces the zero), stored back as that y (min*direction, 8DB5-8DC3) - a y value, never a record number; a side whose deepest defender still has y*direction >= 0 keeps 0; draws the sprite through 8E24, and when the stored y's sign equals the ball y's sign, DS:8328 is set and the y is nonzero, calls 90C5 on the record at DS:8304 (the offside path); called by the tick loop every watched tick after the engine; no RNG in its tree (8E24 and 90C5 call nothing that draws)

name: draw_ball
purpose: restores the old cell of the ball in the screen buffer (DS:7C16 from the background DS:7C1E, rows 0xA0 bytes, +0x90E), picks the glyph from table DS:0880 by height (835F >= 3 when +0x0D is set) and writes the new cell

name: move_referee
purpose: moves the sprite record it is given (DS:82EE, the referee: row +0, column +1, glyph word +4, target row +6, column +7) one cell toward a target from the ball DS:82F6: with param 2 = 0 the ball's column +-1 kept within +-(30 + rand 2) and the row column/4 + 1 clamped to +-5, else the cell one row beyond the ball (the ball's row + 1, its column); redraws through 0791:8E24 in the buffer DS:7C16; called by the tick loop with argument 0 EVERY watched tick, and that path draws exactly one rand(2) (the target column; 214B:0D1C and 0D56 are RNG-free min/max clamps, seg_214B_02.asm:0D1C-0D53), so the seed advances every tick of a watched match

name: switch_to_quick_result
purpose: the R key's action: returns when DS:9A3E, DS:8326 or DS:0C21 is set or no minutes are left (DS:831B = 0); defers (sets DS:7C38, the first time unpacking screen DS:26E4) when the clock is stopped (DS:8325 = 0) or DS:0C20, DS:7C37 or DS:9B55 is set; else sets DS:9A3E and DS:9A3F, clears DS:7C38 and calls 0791:0106(0) (the match board)

name: match_key_poll
purpose: the in-match key poll: on R (or while DS:7C38 is set) calls 0791:92FC, returns when no key waits

name: speaker_rng_step
purpose: steps the LCG 214B:0688 on the second seed DS:8336 (set from the BIOS tick at start-up)

name: speaker_noise
purpose: sounds the speaker at a pitch drawn from 0791:94C9; that stream's only caller

name: watched_match_engine
purpose: the watched match engine, called by the tick loop when DS:9A3E is clear; one call is one sweep of an outer slot loop [bp-2] = 1..0x16 over the pitch records (0x80E8 + 0x16*slot): per slot, when DS:8302 is nonzero and the threshold byte at 0x899 + 0x16*flag + slot is <= DS:8300 (flag = 1 exactly when DS:8303 is set AND DS:8327 is NOT a member of the set CS:9544 - 23E4:08DF returns in ZF, ZF set = not a member), the ball phase runs: the two-word shot counter at DS:80F6 + 2*eq on the keeper's end (2BE5 against DS:7920), 83A2 move_ball, 2FB1, 2996, the keeper special (only when DS:8327 IS a member, 9634 je skips non-members: 2CEC false and (keeper x != ball x, or 2E36) -> 8AE9 on the side's slot-1 record), 59B3 check_woodwork, then the 22-record handle_player_at_ball loop (6188) - the whole block sits INSIDE the slot loop and runs for every slot whose guards pass, up to six ball phases in one sweep (E011 rng-counts.txt); always then the per-slot tail: 8AE9 update_player on the record DS:883[slot] maps to, 2FB1 again when that slot is DS:830B, 94E8 speaker_noise, 8F10 draw_ball, 9372 the key poll; the sweep returns at once when R sets DS:9A3E (96F1), and at slot 0x16 takes 2 off DS:832A when it is nonzero

name: match_clock
purpose: the match clock, while DS:8325 is set: counts DS:831D down to 0, then reloads it with 0x24 and takes a minute from DS:831B (then from DS:8321), shows it (draw_big_digits); at the half's end (DS:831B = DS:8319, or none left: DS:8326) calls 0791:2B0F, whistle(3), delay(4), whistle(6) and returns 1; 0791:D733 zeroes DS:831D at its start, so in a quick match EVERY tick-loop iteration advances a minute - the 0x24 countdown never elapses and the half is CPU-paced (46 D733 calls per half, 831F = 46..91, 831B = 91 - 831F); in a watched match 9564 never writes 831D, so the 0x24 countdown paces the half at ~0x25 ticks per minute and (DS:831F, DS:831D) identifies a tick (9564's sweep, seg_0791_15.asm:946-1140, has no 0x831d operand)
basis: F005; F006; F012; read decompiled/seg_0791_06.c; F013

name: match_tick_loop
purpose: the match tick loop: with DS:9A3E set (quick mode) D733 then the clock 970C, so the half is D733 + 970C per minute; clear (watched), one iteration in order: the action replay 0C65 when DS:7C37 is set (else 15B9 when DS:9B55), 9B55/0C20/7C37 cleared, call 9564, then while still watched call 8CF5 and 9119 with DS:82EE and argument 0, then 970C; loop while 970C returns 0 and the guard [bp+4] (983F pushes 0) holds

name: run_one_half
purpose: one half, both engines: DS:9B41=0, DS:830E=0, 8062 (substitution checks), 2A15, watched-only 2929 and 8CCA (gated on DS:9A3E==0), then 8302=0, 9B55=1, 0C20=0, 7C37=0, the tick loop 97D0 with param 0 (run to the half's end), watched-only the 9079 cleanups per side and on the referee DS:82EE, 8325=0 and the speaker off (214B:1E8D)

name: pre_half_sequence
purpose: the pre-half routine both engines share: per pitch slot 1..22 energy +E gains 2 only when its byte is in CS:99F2={1..30}; no fitness write; DS:9B41=1, screen copies (23E4:025D), 0106, then the wait ED8A (the team screen; it runs unless DS:80FD=0 AND the key DS:A977 is NOT a member of CS:9A12={13 Enter,27 Esc}; 08DF ZF set means not a member, so the preceding Enter makes it wait; no RNG), then kick-off slot DS:830B=0668[(DS:831A==0 ? 1 : 0)]+10 (ONE-byte store 9AFC preserves DS:830C), DS:832A=0x50, then 983F; the team-screen state is after the energy increment

name: penalty_shootout
purpose: the shoot-out's round bookkeeping: five kicks per side (counters on the stack), 9B93 (managed, by hand) or 9ED3 (unmanaged, ranked by 278A(pitch,0xC)) fills the taker arrays, A006 plays each kick through the watched engine, the win test on DS:9B3C/9B3D, sudden death after five; reached only from F098 F179 when the fixture is drawn (+3 = 2) and a decider (DS:7C36: fixture +2 in the set DS:693A = {0x10}), so a drawn friendly ends at full time; the only printer of `penalty shoot out` (F005)
basis: F005; F015; read code/seg_0791_16.asm; read code/seg_0791_23.asm

name: prepare_computer_sides
purpose: match set-up for the computer sides: for t = 0 then 1, only when 0B77 is zero for the team, calls 0791:B11F, then 1771:34E7 (clear the players' +0xF and re-derive it), then 0791:BD83(t), in that order; a managed side is skipped

name: match_setup
purpose: per-match set-up: clears the commentary ring and the quick flags, draws the kick-off side; also clears the tactic-change flags DS:8332 + t and DS:8334 + t

name: host_country
purpose: the venue's host country for a fixture: the fixture's second team (+6) unless 1771:5A03 (fixture_kind_in_result_set) holds for the fixture, then the country stored at [A923] + 0x2C + 2 * continent, where continent is the fixture's second country's continent (country +0x2C, read at A72E), or slot 5 when [A923]+0x40 is set

name: pick_best_bench_keeper
purpose: the best bench squad slot 12..20 by DS:0x8D5[14*pos + role], where pos is the POSITION ARGUMENT (the outgoing keeper's +6, AA56), the value halved when the candidate is not two-footed and its foot differs from the expectation (count > 3); skips the unavailable

name: pick_bench_by_formation

name: set_marking_words
purpose: the marking words (squad words DS:9A3E + 0x28 t + 2 slot): per team it builds the own positions string (slots 2..11; 0 for a sweeper, a player with +0x10 bit 7 (Protect zone, F008) or an unavailable one) and the opponent's, takes out the opposing men already marked by a protect-zone player, runs 1771:3E2F in the order above, then in the last loop (slots 2..11) a player with bit 7 keeps his word, else the word is cleared and, when the team's +0x2D element 8 is set, set to the opponent picked (0 if none); a sweeper in slot 2 gets 0; the keeper (slot 1) is outside the loops; called by 0791:230C, which both engines reach

name: draw_player_screen

name: edit_own_tactics

name: draw_squad_list

name: draw_squad_screen
purpose: draws the squad list (1771:4D8A) and frames, then the card of the selected player DS:0C1B (1771:42BC) and its highlight

name: view_squad_screen
purpose: a read-only squad screen (1771:4E22 with a 20-item list move; Esc exits), opened from 1771:26B9 by Space

name: quicksort_words
purpose: a quicksort of words; 1771:52CC sorts the squad words with it, and it swaps each slot's saved position byte along with its squad word (214B:007B), so every player gets his own +6 back after the sort

name: sort_squad_by_position

name: pool_quicksort

name: sort_pool_by_position

name: stage_qualifying

name: recompute_country_ranks

name: run_stage
purpose: dispatches on the stage byte [DS:A923]+0x3C: 2 or 5 to 1771:6730, 3..8 to other routines

name: advance_player_age
purpose: skips player 0 (7E64), else increments the age byte +1 (7E6F, wraps at 255) and calls 1771:32EB to recompute +4

name: recreate_retired_player
purpose: re-creates a computer country's retiree in place (from 1771:7FDF at the ageing gate): saves +6 (7E9D), make_player(1, old +7, old +0, player) (7EA6-7EC0), +1 = DS:110C[gk] + b - a with a, b = rand(6) (7EC3-7EF9; DS:110C = 19 1C), 1771:32EB (7F01), +8..+0xB and +0x10 zeroed (7F09-7F19), a new initial from 1771:0000 at [DS:9B70]+player (7F1F-7F2D), +6 restored (7F36); keeps the surname, +0x11 and +0xF's other bits; ten draws

name: retirement_test
purpose: retires when (DS:110E[gk] < +1 AND the caps word +8 == 0) OR (+1 > +2 + 5), gk = (+7 == 0), DS:110E = 1E 21 (30 outfield, 33 goalkeeper); deterministic, no RNG; at the year end 1771:7FDF runs it only for computer countries (its 0B77 branch), in the second pass, on the record the first pass aged

name: age_one_player
purpose: calls 1771:7E4A, then writes +0x11 (scorer_count) = 0 unconditionally (7FD4), resetting the year's top-scorer count that 0791:B3B7 keeps

name: age_country_squad

name: yearly_ageing

name: stage_end
purpose: decrements the state's rounds byte +0x3D; at 0 advances the stage byte +0x3C by 1 wrapped into [2,8] (214B:1D6F), tests the new stage against the set CS:81E8 = {2,3,5,7} (the ageing gate) and calls 1771:80DA for members, sets +0x40 = (stage > 4) and +0x3D = 1 + (stage == 4) + 3*(stage == 8)

name: make_player
purpose: makes one player record (flag, club position, country, player): +0 country, +7 club position, +6 = +7, +5 = rand(16), +1 = DS:118A[gk] - b + a (rand(7) each), +2 via 1771:3291, +3 = country_rating + 0x7F (flag 1) or that - 10 - rand(10) (flag 0), +4 via 32EB, +0xC = rand(32), +0xF's bits via 1771:3431, +0xD/+0xE via 1771:3558, +0x12 = 0x7FFF; writes no name byte and not +8..+0xB, +0x10, +0x11

name: make_squad
purpose: sets the RNG word to the country number (97ED), copies +0x2B to +0x29 and +0x2A to +0x28, stores country_rating in [A91F]+3(+0x2E)+1, then makes squad slots 1..20 with 1771:96D3(1, DS:9F02[20 country + slot], country, player); called by 1771:9A40 at a new game and by a rank-swap branch of 1771:26B9

name: make_pool_player
purpose: makes the next extra pool player of position p2 through 1771:96D3(..., 0): increments the caller's counter, stores the player number 0xA00 + counter in DS:A927[counter], then draws the record
basis: F007; F011; read decompiled/seg_1771_06.c; read code/seg_1771_14.asm

basis: F007; F011; read decompiled/seg_1771_06.c; read code/seg_1771_14.asm

purpose: at a new game: 1771:9A40 (country records and squads), then the state [DS:A923]: year +0x3A = DS:A9FD + 1 made even, +0x38 = 0, +0x40 = (+0x3A mod 4 = 2), stage byte +0x3C = DS:118E[+0x40], options +0x3D = 1, +0x3E = 2, +0x3F = 1, +0x41 = 1, two 80-char strings from DS:9B7D/9B81, and an empty fixture list (A92B+0x4B40 = 0xFF)

name: u2138_empty_stub

name: u2139_alloc_arrays
purpose: 16 calls to 214B:0A62 with sizes (0x810,0x8387,0xBF5,...) storing far pointers into DS:9B68..9B78 and A917..A93F (the player and country arrays), then 23E4 file/text calls; array allocation and unit init

name: u214b_fill_words

name: u214b_write_string_at_fwd

name: u214b_write_string_at_fwd_set_attr

name: u214b_ask_yes_no

name: u214b_unpack_screen_796a_to_back

purpose: Copies 0xA0 bytes (one text row) at row offset 0xF00 of the screen buffer DS:A96A to a save area at DS:AA04

name: u214b_restore_bottom_line
purpose: Copies 0xA0 bytes from the save area DS:AA04 back to row offset 0xF00 of the screen buffer DS:A96A

name: u214b_hide_cursor
purpose: INT 10h (via 235C:000B Intr, int number 0x10) AH=2 set cursor position to column 1, row 0x1A (off screen), hiding the text cursor

name: u214b_lcg_step

name: u214b_random_1_to_n

name: u214b_key_pressed

name: u214b_wait_key_in_set
purpose: Copies a 32-byte set from a far pointer and loops 08DD until the key code is a member of the set

name: u214b_number_to_string
purpose: Converts a number to a 20-char string (Str-style call in 23E4:12F6) and copies it to the result

name: u214b_fatal_message_halt
purpose: Shows a message with press-any-key (04F8) then calls a 23E4 routine (probably Halt)

name: u214b_get_mem_zeroed

name: u214b_printer_status

name: u214b_min_longint

name: u214b_max_longint

name: send_off
purpose: the sending-off: emits 2AD4(0x33), sets +0x10 bit 6 and clears bit 5 (1791:7B24), walks the player off (7881); then calls 7CC5(pitch, delta_high=-2, flag=1) so the sent-off player's +0xC becomes clamp(s8(+0xC)-2,1,255) and DS:9B07[side*20+slot] is set; then loops slots 1..11 of the OTHER team (slot_by_2B51 = the side NOT carrying the ball): per slot 2956 == 0 (available) calls 7CC5(pitch, delta_high=+2, flag=0), so +0xC := clamp(s8(+0xC)+2,1,255) and DS:9B07 is NOT updated; finally 0x7B24 < 0xC (or substitute_player in the manage-then-C48D branch for unmanaged sides). The +2 to the other team is a static gain that follows every sending-off, with persist = False (DS:9B07 is preserved); the -2 to the sent-off player is the only sent-off-side store of the event; the XI is re-sorted by 230C's pairwise compare-and-swap (key 0x0E for unavailable, else the position byte +6; jb on key[i] < key[j] swaps slots i and j fully — squad words, 9B07 form bytes and 0x80E8 pitch records; equal keys never swap; two removed players can reverse their original relative order), the bench untouched

name: booking
purpose: yellow card: emits 2AD4(0x32), walks the referee to the offender (90C5/9079), delays (match_delay), calls 214B:0C79 to set +0x10 bit 5, increments DS:7B85[side*10] (side booking count), increments DS:8321 (matches-bookings tally, capped at 5); when the side is unmanaged (1771:0B77 false) calls 1771:33CD force_tactic4_off (sets +0x0F bit 7 and clears bit 4 on the offender). The routine does NOT call 7CC5 and does NOT write +0xC — the listing shows no direct writer of player +0xC for the booking; the listing establishes that a yellow card is a status-bit store (and an unmanged-side tactic change), not a confidence drop

name: injure
purpose: the injury: emits 2B28(0x34), sets +0xE := 0 (the injury store, F018), walks the player off (7881), then calls 7CC5(pitch, delta_high=-2, flag=1) so the player's +0xC becomes clamp(s8(+0xC)-2,1,255) and DS:9B07[side*20+slot] is set; DS:8321 (matches-bookings tally) is incremented if below 5; for unmanaged sides (1771:0B77 false) calls C88D substitute_player (with the freshly unavailable slot, slot+5, country record) which calls C5DC refresh_pitch_slot to bring a bench player on, otherwise sets DS:9B40 = 1 to surface a managed-side in-match menu. The -2 confidence change is the same as send_off head; +0xE := 0 is the injury store (F018); the walk-off 7881 (7DAA) runs unconditionally once 7A43 allowed the injury (it stores the off-pitch position DS:0640 into the pitch record, 796C), so a managed side with no substitutions left and an outfield injury gets no bench prompt but the player is off the pitch and keeps his squad slot

name: foul_dispatch
purpose: the card and injury rolls of one foul on the fouling slot DS:830C (victim DS:830B): draw1 = the next byte of the 255-entry table at DS:8337 (261A; DS:8437 is the index, 1..255 wrapping); draw1 < 4 -> a booking (798D), or a sending off (7B77) when the player's +0x10 element 5 is already set; else a chance 1/32 (06D0(0x20)) of a sending off (7B77); then draw2 = the next table byte, and draw2 == 1 -> 7D56 on the player of lower hardness (1771:2FFB) of DS:830C and DS:830B, a tie injuring DS:830B (7F99 cmp al, dl; jbe). Called only from 8206 (watched) and D5C1 (quick); 798D, 7B77 and 7D56 have no other caller. The table holds rand(16) - 1 (0..15), so 4/16 and 1/16 are expectations of the table, not of every match (E011's table: 66/255 below 4, 13/255 equal to 1). The routine writes no +0xC; the callees do

name: draw_table_byte

The table is initialised by 0791:2648 with random(0x10)-1 (values 0..15). It is NOT a tick counter (R5); it is a pre-shuffled draw. Called twice by 0791:7EEF foul_dispatch and many times in the in-match engine (seg_0791_03 and seg_0791_04) for player movement, marking, tackle resolution and similar decisions gated by the same table

name: team_panel_aggregate
purpose: per country: sets DS:9B5A..9B64 := 6 (six 16-bit words). Then for slot = 1..11: if 1771:3216(squad[slot-1]) == 0 (available): DS:9B5A += min(32, s8(players[squad[slot-1]].morale)) (no lower clamp; the 214B:0D1C helper returns min(32, s8(+0xC)) only — a -128 player byte contributes -128); DS:9B5C += s8(players.fitness) when s8(players.energy) > 0; DS:9B5E += (player_hardness(...) & 0xff); DS:9B60 += s8(players.energy); DS:9B62 += players.age; DS:9B64 += players.caps. The DS:9B5A accumulator is a 16-bit word wrapped mod 0x10000 on each add (line 1067). Then DS:9B5A..DS:9B64 /= 0x0B (unsigned 16-bit divide, line 1093), and DS:9B5A := max(1, quotient). DS:9B5A is therefore the team morale aggregate max(1, ((6 + sum_of_min(32, s8(morale)) for available starters) & 0xFFFF) // 11), recomputed every time 1771:157D draw_team_panel runs; the only consumer of DS:9B5A in the listing is the same routine's caller, which selects the morale string via DS:78A3[DS:9B5A]. No other writer of DS:9B5A exists in the listing. For [128, 0, ..., 0] the hand-traced original returns 5946 (= (6 + (-128)) & 0xFFFF = 65414, 65414 // 11); the reviewer's Unicorn run of the original listing bytes confirms 5946

name: choose_marking_target

name: update_marking_destination

name: bind_pitch_player

name: initialize_pitch_player

name: update_fixture_player_state

name: restore_match_player_state

name: adjust_player_confidence
purpose: adds signed delta word to signed player +0xC with word wrapping; clips to 1..32 on each call; result, bench, pool and scorer callers

name: fixture_confidence_delta

purpose: stage 4 builder: rounds byte +0x3D = 2: per continent two semi-finals (kind 0x65: winner of B1 v runner-up of B2, winner of B2 v runner-up of B1) through add_fixture_with_bonus (host as side B when it plays); +0x3D = 1: third place (0x66, the losers) and final (0x67, the winners)

name: mark_playoff_fixture_managed
purpose: sets byte 0 = 0xFE on the fixture just written (7090) when it is in a managed country's continent

name: stage_playoffs
purpose: stage 6 builder: for continents 3 (Africa) and 4 (Asia) and g = 1..4 two legs of winner(group 9-g) v winner(group g), kind 6; leg 1 is copied to the aggregate record 0x961 + pair (read by 85F7 and 71B2)

name: stage_world_cup_groups
purpose: stage 7 builder (class 1): host [A923]+0x36 = winner of a random group of continent 1 or 2; 8 finals groups of 4 = Europe winner g, Europe runner-up of group 9-g, America winner g, play-off winner g (slot permutation random); kind 7 single round robin (48 fixtures); 320 friendlies for all 128 countries (order table pairs)

name: stage_world_cup_knockout
purpose: stage 8 builder, by +0x3D = 4/3/2/1: last 16 (kind 8: winner of group i v runner-up of group 9-i), quarter-finals (200), semi-finals (0xC9), third place (0xCA) and final (0xCB), each from the previous round's winners/losers; host as side B when it plays

name: sort_group_table
purpose: rebuilds one 4-slot group table from the last 12 entries of each country's fixture list (played fixtures whose kind equals the stage byte): wins/draws/losses, goals for/against, points 2-1-0, then an exchange sort on points, goal difference, goals for; no coin

name: decide_playoff_aggregates
purpose: for each completed pair of stage-6 legs builds the aggregate record 0x961 + k: totals in +0/+1, winner byte +3 = 1 (side B) iff B's total is larger or equal totals and leg 2's A goals >= leg 1's A goals; the country-parity coin after it is unreachable

name: update_group_tables
purpose: after every played fixture, for stages in CS:8737 = {2, 3, 5, 7}: calls sort_group_table for the continents (4, or 1 at stage 7) and groups (8, or 2 at stage 3) of the stage's table; at stage 6 calls decide_playoff_aggregates

name: announce_stage_draw
purpose: the manager's news after a stage is built (stages in CS:7099 = {2, 3, 5, 7}): the host (continent host [A923]+0x2C+2c at class 0, [+0x36] at class 1), the manager's group and its three opponents (rating comparisons), "IS TO HOST", "GROUPS ARE ANNOUNCED", "QUALIFIES FOR"

name: pick_pass_target
purpose: chooses a pass receiver: mode b is element 3 set, or (2C54 and not keeper); initial cutoff DS:0778[b] + draw_table_byte() is 2 + draw for short or 24 + draw for long. The descending first pass accepts an eligible teammate at Manhattan distance <= the current cutoff for short, > it for long; the first accepted player needs no coin, later replacements need a coin, and acceptance sets the cutoff to that player's distance. If no candidate was accepted, an ascending fallback returns the last available non-holder without a distance test. Thus element 3 changes a receiver preference, not an absolute distance guarantee

name: holder_action_choice
purpose: what the ball holder does when his 5049 gate fires: far forward (row * direction >= 24 + draw, abs(x) > 3): 3DF6; deep in his own end (row * direction < -8) or draw = 1: pass (3323); else by position: 3 and 4 pass when element 1 is clear and dribble (move_ball_to_slot) when set; 7 and 8 dribble when element 1 is set unless random_is_one(3); 10 and 11 always dribble; 12 and 13 pass with random_is_one(DS:07E4[position == 12]); other positions pass

name: chase_ball_gate
purpose: the defending player's go-to-the-ball test in 57AC: 0 for a keeper slot or a slot on the ball's side; else 1 when 2EB8 (the ball position test) holds and (2EF0 holds, or effective element 6 is clear), else 0; so with sag back (element 6 clear) a defender close to the ball goes for it, with stand ground (set) only when 2EF0 holds

name: is_keeper_slot
purpose: 1 when the pitch slot is 1 or 12 (the two goalkeepers' slots), else 0
